text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Actually, there's a place I 
want the two of us to go to—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan. Actually, there's a place I 
want to go with just the two of us--

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Are you free tonight?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Maruzensky to the beach at night, 
we found... a test of courage event being 
held.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
One of my junior friends taught me!♪ 
Apparently it's all the rage among the hip 
young folks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple: head for the goal 
along the beach. It seems you get prizes 
depending on your placement.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
1st place gets a 
'Make-Anything-Into-A-Figure Ticket'!? If 
it's anything, does that mean Tac-chan 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! I'd absolutely want to display 
that on the dashboard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the test of courage tournament 
began!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Kyaa!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you scared me, it's just konjac! 
Jeez, give me a break!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's surprising, but so much fun! 
Come on, let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Usually acting so much like an 
upperclassman, she was delightfully acting 
her age for once. As we pressed close and 
moved forward together—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Eek!?
Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A teary-eyed Sweep Tosho came leaping out 
from behind the driftwood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, w-wait... Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-chan! Oh dear, what's the matter? 
Are you okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if her playful demeanor from moments 
ago had vanished into thin air, her 
expression instantly sharpened into that 
of a reliable senior.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, really! It's just, during the 
test of courage, I got separated from Rob 
Roy... and then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, but... Rob Roy is such a 
crybaby, she might be in tears right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears gradually welled up in Sweep Tosho's 
eyes as well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, would it be alright if we 
save winning for next time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan, would it be alright if we 
won next time instead?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Sweep-chan. We'll help you 
look for Rob Roy-chan, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading the way and matching her pace, she 
was the very picture of the dependable 
"Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's basically a single straight path, so 
if we didn't run into them, they must be 
ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but it was dark and the road was 
wide, so it's not impossible that they 
simply didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which way they went? What do you 
think, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: Let's head for the finish line.
Let's head back to the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder which way they went? What do you 
think, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: Let's head for the finish line.
Let's head back to the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, let's head for the goal first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking for a while, I eventually 
emerged into an open area that looked like 
the goal.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Umm, I wonder if Rob Roy-chan is here...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah! There's Sweep! —Wait, Maruzen-san!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Rob Roy, you were with Scarlet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We were doing a test of courage and 
just happened to... Still, I'm glad we 
found you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Rob Roy! Why did you just dash off 
on your own?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I, I...! I was sure you were 
right behind me...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, we managed to meet up safely 
like this, so case closed! Come on, let's 
make up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, not at all! ...It's not like I'm 
mad. Just don't go making me worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sweep-san. And Maruzen-san too—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. If you'd like, here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Zenno Rob Roy presented the 
prize for winning the test of courage 
tournament.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was just running with all my 
might, and somehow I ended up winning.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much for finding Sweep-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky gave a gentle smile to the 
junior who timidly held out her ticket.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad, but since you have it, why 
don't you and Sweep-chan use it together?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"So, nothing would make me happier than 
hearing all about what kind of lovely 
figure you made♪"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For example... for Rob Roy-chan, maybe a 
storybook character!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Sweep-chan would have so much 
fun if she could make her own favorite 
familiar and wand."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But... um, er... S-Sorry, th-thank you 
so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Maruzensky smiled warmly as she 
spotted the two of them discussing what 
figures to make.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Well then, shall we head over to the 
starting point real quick?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking for a while, I eventually 
made it back to where we started. And 
right then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sweep-san! Ticket-san, I found 
Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Thank goodness! I was so worwied!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Why are you guys...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I met Rob Roy-chan at the 
finish line and heard what happened!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I left Rob Roy-san in Scarlet-san's care 
and went looking for Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see! What a relief~ With Scarlet-chan 
along, we've got nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyuuu~...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
T-That wasn't what it sounded like! It's 
not like I'm hungry or anything—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now that I'm relieved, I've suddenly 
gotten hungry.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it, I feel like there 
was a milkshake stand near the finish 
line...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my♪ Well, with that case closed, how 
about we all go grab a drink!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we safely met up at the finish 
line and headed over to the milkshake 
shop, but—

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I could only prepare enough for 
6 people. That means we'll be one short...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, six servings please! I 
don't need any for myself—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, let's do that. Thanks, 
Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, let's do that. Thanks, 
Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, beneath the starry sky, we 
savored our milkshakes while listening to 
the sound of the ocean waves.
